text: Drinking or injecting bleach or disinfectant is dangerous and can cause serious harm or death; it does not cure viral infections.
The Moon is a natural rocky satellite of Earth; it is not a hologram and has been visited by crewed and robotic missions.
No pill can safely cause the loss of thirty pounds of body fat in a single day; rapid extreme weight loss claims are fraudulent.
5G is a radio communication technology for data transmission; it cannot control the weather or create storms.
Vaccines do not contain microchips; they contain antigens that train the immune system, and their ingredients are publicly documented.
Treated tap water is tested for safety and does not transform people; claims of water causing zombification are baseless.
The Sun is a star powered by nuclear fusion; it is not a lightbulb and cannot be replaced by one.
Gravity is a fundamental force that cannot be switched off; objects with mass always attract one another.
Eating chocolate does not make a person immortal; no food confers immortality, and human lifespan has biological limits.
Humans cannot regrow amputated limbs by eating fruit; limb regeneration is not possible in humans with any known food.
Clouds are made of tiny water droplets and ice crystals, not cotton candy or any edible substance.
Ocean water is saline water composed of water and dissolved salts; it is not made of soda.
Regular moderate physical activity is associated with reduced cardiovascular disease risk in large cohort studies.
Childhood vaccination campaigns have reduced measles incidence; high vaccine coverage prevents outbreaks.
Handwashing with soap reduces the transmission of many respiratory and gastrointestinal infections.
Heating paper currency does not increase its quantity or value; money cannot be physically duplicated by microwaving.
